direction.description: Filter by funding direction. 'positive' = longs pay shorts (bullish funding). 'negative' = shorts pay longs (bearish funding). Default: 'all'.

min_oi_usd.description: Minimum open interest in USD to filter out illiquid markets (e.g. 500000 for $500K). Default: 0.

sort_by.description: Sort order. 'abs_funding' (default) = highest absolute rate first. 'funding' = most positive first. 'open_interest' = largest OI first.

symbol.description: Filter to a specific asset symbol (e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL). Case-insensitive. Omit for all assets.

ai.intuitek.stall/inputSchemaProjection.limitation: inputSchema is the existing runtime Zod projection. Canonical registry constraints are retained here; not_projected constraints are not enforced by that conversion. Structural changes and added schema metadata are reported separately. Declared contracts do not verify outcomes.

description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.059 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Returns current perpetual funding rates for 200+ assets on Hyperliquid DEX, sorted by absolute funding magnitude. Includes 8-hour and annualized rates, open interest, mark price, and directional signal (longs-pay or shorts-pay). Use before entering a perpetual position to factor funding cost/income into strategy ROI, or to scan for high-rate short-bias opportunities in delta-neutral strategies.

name: funding-rates

rates.description: Perpetual funding rates matching filters, sorted as requested.

direction.description: Who pays whom. Positive rate = longs pay shorts. Negative = shorts pay longs.

funding_rate_8h.description: 8-hour funding rate as a decimal (e.g. 0.0001 = 0.01% per 8h).

funding_rate_annualized_pct.description: Annualized funding rate in percent (e.g. 10.95 = 10.95% p.a.). Multiply funding_rate_8h × 3 × 365.

total_matched.description: Assets matching the given filters before limit was applied.
